title: Why Clams Casino's beats are so euphoric
creator: Beat breakdown
why: A breakdown of how blown-out, reverb-drenched samples create that weightless cloud-rap haze.
note: Steal the move: pitch a vocal sample down, drown it in reverb, then sidechain it to the kick.

title: Make a melodic house track start to finish
creator: Production Music Live
why: Watch a full loop become a finished arrangement — the part most tracks die before reaching.
note: Note where they use subtractive arrangement: strip elements to build tension before the drop.

title: Sound-design in Serum 2 like the pros
creator: Sound design tutorial
why: Wavetable, modulation and FX moves that separate a flat patch from a pro-sounding one.
note: Try one idea tonight: assign an LFO to wavetable position for instant movement.

title: An Ableton + Serum 2 sound-design session
creator: Sound design session
why: Real-time patch building inside Ableton — see the workflow, not just the finished sound.
note: Watch how they resample a synth to audio, then re-process it in Simpler for new textures.

title: Serum 2: LFO lead & pad for melodic house / techno
creator: Synth tutorial
why: Modulation-first patching — the difference between a static pad and one that breathes.
note: Copy the LFO routing onto a bass patch and you've got a moving Reese in minutes.
